findings: Coverage shows one full rectangular interior and separate partially generated perimeter bands; no interior header or full-status gaps.
The broad east and west mountain classifications correspond to elevated bands in the independently decoded height samples; no obvious world-scale inversion of mountain and lowland classes was seen.
The central-to-southern water pattern is consistent between observed water samples and terrain class maps.
Fine GEO fragmentation is visible and retained, not presented as named coherent geographic provinces.
GEO labels show only the largest 35 components for legibility; all memberships remain queryable in SQLite.
Map coordinate extents describe the 64-block grid footprint. Edge cells may overhang exact full chunk bounds; use manifest full_block_bounds for the completed-world boundary.
limits: These maps share underlying samples, so agreement does not independently validate semantic landform labels.
Valleys, mountain passes, bays, islands and peninsulas require local higher-resolution investigation or safe scene observation.
Biome colors are categorical; the full color lookup is reports/map-legends.json.
